title: In-flight refueling of a U-2
description: Black-and-white photograph taken from a tanker looking down through window framing at a refueling boom connected to an aircraft below, captioned "In-flight refueling of a U-2." Chapter 5 text (page 200) discusses Project NIMBUS flights over Cuba from Laughlin and Edwards AFB and August 1962 missions 3086 and 3088.
